comment: INERT example (never a live config.json). Simulated robot for docs/ROBOTICS.md: sensors + kinetic actuators + sound, all safe flat-file mocks. Add a real model block. On real hardware, point each command at an absolute path OUTSIDE the workspace (doctor warns about workspace-resident kinetic scripts) and swap the mock sound scripts for aplay/arecord. See docs/ROBOTICS.md.

tools.name: read_sensors
tools.description: Read the robot's sensors: pose, heading, battery %, obstacle flag. Returns JSON.

tools.name: drive_motor
tools.description: Drive the wheels. left/right are signed speeds; duration in ticks.

tools.name: move_arm
tools.description: Set an arm joint to an angle (degrees).

tools.name: stop_all
tools.description: Command every actuator to a safe state. Use when a sensor reading is unsafe or on any doubt.

tools.name: set_led
tools.description: Set the status LED (on/off). A non-kinetic indicator.
